env.signaling: PORT=4444 node node_modules/y-webrtc/bin/server.js; both apps set localStorage unwritten.signaling = ws://127.0.0.1:4444 (first action of each)
env.guestB: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$TMPDIR/ud-followup-vp-b (empty) bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9334; restarted once with the same userData (see `restart`)
env.build: main at 70f5eba + the uncommitted rev 6 working tree incl. the visitor-position change (playerProbe.ts, continentActions.ts, usePositionAutosave.ts)
env.doorNumber: A's door number is derived from its instance id (random suffix), so it differs per run: this run got ZTVJCV. Replace ZTVJCV below with the number A's `actions` prints.
env.probe: the `eval` steps that return {sample, visiting, chunk, teleport, continent, anchor, worlds} import the dev modules /engine/playerProbe.ts and /state/index.ts read-only (same module instances vite serves the app); the one step that calls leaveContinent() imports /net/continentActions.ts because no button reaches it from foreign land (see result.md)
env.order: actions (A) -> guest (B) -> together (B walks while A captures) -> guestVisit -> guestLeavePlayAndReopen -> guestRoomDial -> guestLeaveContinent -> guestCloseWindow -> restart (shell) -> guestAfterRestart; `shell` steps are run by hand between drive calls

model: openai · gpt-5.4-mini (witnessing the two origin chunks only)

guest.eval: (async()=>{const p=await import('/engine/playerProbe.ts');const st=await import('/state/index.ts');const s=p.samplePlayer();const c=st.useContinentStore.getState();return JSON.stringify({sample:s&&{sceneId:s.sceneId,x:+s.x.toFixed(2),z:+s.z.toFixed(2)},visiting:s?p.isVisiting(s):null,chunk:st.useEngineStore.getState().chunk,teleport:st.useEngineStore.getState().teleport,continent:c.status.kind+(c.status.code?(' '+c.status.code):''),anchor:c.anchor,worlds:c.worlds.map(w=>({id:w.worldId,anchor:w.anchor,door:w.door,online:w.online}))})})()
